hazards.control: Pressure test before opening to the well; bleed down and verify zero before breaking any connection.

name: Kill wing valve
function: The valve on the opposite side of the cross with a companion flange, used to pump into the tubing for a kill, a treatment, or a pressure test.

tabs.overview: Manual gate valve; the companion flange is blind between jobs with a gauge or a needle valve on it.
tabs.safety: Blind flange and gauge inspected with the tree.
tabs.evidence: API 6A scope for trees (S1), API Spec 14A for safety valves (S29), API 11D1 for packers (S21), field practice (S9). Photographs read for proportion only.
